csv_project_name: DB for Rolling Meadows Human Services Facility Remodel
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Rolling Meadows is seeking proposals from qualified architectural and engineering consulting firms for the full-service design and construction administration of a new Human Services Facility. This project encompasses a comprehensive remodel of the first-floor entryway to create a more inviting and accessible presence, as well as the build-out of the facility located on the second and third floors of 2214 Algonquin Road. The interior space includes approximately 3,250 square feet on the second floor and 2,087 square feet on the third floor, including common areas. Provide full architectural services including programming, schematic design, design development, construction documents, and construction administration. B. Provide space planning, material selection, furniture, fixtures, and equipment (FF&E) specification and interior finishes. C. Develop detailed cost estimates at various points in the projects. Identify value engineering opportunities. Assist with obtaining all necessary permits and approvals from relevant jurisdictional entities (e.g., City of Rolling Meadows, Illinois Department of Public Health, etc.) E. Develop a comprehensive project schedule and ensure timely completion. F. Oversee and manage the construction phase, including site visits, review of submittals, progress meetings, and quality control. G. Coordinate with City staff, City Council, the Human Services Department, and other project stakeholders.
